data.name: Najir
data.gender_notes: Najir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'naj-' meaning victory, and '-ir' meaning the gods. This name evokes the triumphant power of the divine and is bestowed upon children born into families who seek divine favor and protection. The name Najir carries the meaning “Victory of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Najir usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Najir belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name Najir is also mentioned in the 16th century Marathi literature as a local deity worshipped in the region of Belagavi in Karnataka, India. He is believed to be a guardian deity of the forests and an auspicious symbol of prosperity.
